query:
SELECT 
  ph.cardId,
  c.name,
  c.snkrdunkId,
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  ph.grade
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.snkrdunkId IN ('210022', '781745', '819562', '150847')
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
ORDER BY c.snkrdunkId, ph.soldAt DESC
LIMIT 50;
